description: This file defines the DataElementFile class, which is a part of the WPEFramework Core namespace. It manages file data elements, including file handling, memory mapping, and related operations. The class provides methods for accessing file properties, reloading file info, loading, and syncing data, and handles platform-specific details for Windows and Linux.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: A class representing a file data element that supports file operations, memory mapping, and platform-specific handling within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the file.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file is currently open and valid.

methods.name: Storage
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying File object.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the file.

methods.name: ReloadFileInfo
methods.description: Reloads the file information from the filesystem.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the file data into memory.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the in-memory data with the file.

methods.name: Reallocation
methods.description: Handles reallocation of the file data, virtual method.

methods.name: OpenMemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Opens a memory-mapped file with the required size.
